principles: No generated or inferred values may appear as source truth.
Public dashboard fields must be whitelisted.
Internal IDs, backend diagnostics, source_gap flags, and model labels are not public fields.
Normalization must preserve raw source evidence internally while exposing one canonical presentation value.

field_rules.rule: State values exposed by API must use one canonical display format per country and retain source/raw state internally.
acceptance: canonical_state or state_canonical is available for API clients when state is present
raw source value is not discarded in internal provenance
public dashboard does not mix abbreviations and long forms for the same jurisdiction

field_rules.rule: Money fields used for sorting must expose a numeric normalized value and display value separately.
acceptance: numeric value sorts numerically, not lexicographically
missing or undisclosed values sort after disclosed numeric values unless a filter explicitly includes undisclosed

field_rules.rule: Dates exposed by API must be ISO-8601 date or datetime strings, with source/raw dates retained internally.
acceptance: invalid BSON or out-of-range dates are blocked from display
records without disclosed dates are labeled by business copy or omitted from date-ranked modules
date-ranked modules sort from parsed normalized dates

field_rules.rule: Every visible metric, tool response, and partner API packet must have a source lineage, timestamp, and query receipt.
acceptance: source_lineage is non-empty for fact packets
stale packets are blocked or explicitly marked unavailable internally

field_rules.rule: Public payloads must not expose object IDs, source_gap, backend names, model names, stack traces, or service diagnostics.
acceptance: public payload scanner finds zero forbidden fields
dashboard leakage scanner finds zero forbidden labels
partner API schema documents allowed fields and deprecations
